mapper.select: SELECT v.`id`, v.`shop_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, sv.`stock` , sv.begin_time , sv.end_time FROM tb_voucher v LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON v.id = sv.voucher_id WHERE v.shop_id = #{shopId} AND v.status = 1

SELECT v.`id`, v.`shop_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, v.`status`, sv.`stock`, sv.begin_time, sv.end_time, s.`name` AS shop_name, s.`images` AS shop_images FROM tb_voucher v INNER JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON v.id = sv.voucher_id LEFT JOIN tb_shop s ON s.id = v.shop_id WHERE v.type = 1 AND v.status = 1 AND sv.stock > 0 AND sv.begin_time <= NOW() AND sv.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY sv.end_time ASC, v.id DESC

SELECT v.`id`, v.`shop_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, v.`status`, sv.`stock`, sv.begin_time, sv.end_time, s.`name` AS shop_name, s.`images` AS shop_images FROM tb_voucher v LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON v.id = sv.voucher_id LEFT JOIN tb_shop s ON s.id = v.shop_id WHERE v.status = 1 ORDER BY v.type ASC, v.id DESC
